name: SubFlowOutput
caption: Return SubFlow Output

configuration.description: The values returned to the calling Run SubFlow step: array of {"name": string, "type": "Value"|"Reference", "tableNo": integer, "value": string}. name = output name seen by the caller (truncated to 30 chars there); type defaults to Value; tableNo is only meaningful for Reference (the editor derives it from the selected reference and writes 0 for Value rows); value = SmartText for Value rows, a wrapped reference selector {{name}} for Reference rows. An empty array returns no outputs.

outputs.name: <outputs[].name>
outputs.when: one entry per outputs[] row; 'reference' with that row's tableNo when type = Reference. Shown for information only – the step terminates the SubFlow, the values surface on the caller's Run SubFlow step.

notes: Contract with the caller: the calling Run SubFlow step's outputs[] are generated from THIS step's configuration.outputs (name/type/tableNo) of the SubFlow version it pins. If a SubFlow contains several Return SubFlow Output steps (e.g. in different branches), only the first one found (document order, depth-first into edges) defines the caller's declared outputs – keep all of them identical.

Runtime: SmartFields in each value are resolved, the step builds a JSON object {name: value} (all values as strings), stops the SubFlow immediately and hands the object to the caller, which adds one value output per key.
A SubFlow that ends without reaching this step returns no outputs (not an error).

Reference-typed returns: the value is a selector such as {{FindCustomer_Rec}}; Reference selectors are not substituted with scalar text by the engine, so what the caller receives is not established by the source. Prefer returning scalar values (No., SystemId) and re-finding the record in the caller.
